_comment: Subsystem modules for module-scoped audits (Development_Tools/ModuleMap/module_map.py). Every tracked file belongs to exactly one module, is a sharedTable (rows attributed by the UID or LocalizationKey they name), or is a picture/.art file owned by the module whose card names it. Region modules own a place's Environment and Location cards by the anchored glob CardData/*/FT_<Place>*; every FT_Path* card names two places, so all paths, swims and climbs live in one travel module. Resource/GIF is not derived from cards, so each GIF is claimed by name. `module_map.py check FarTerritory` must exit 0.

modules.name: Getting There and Island Start
modules.summary: Brackwater Mouth, Driftwood Shore and Seaward Sands, the Dugout and Outrigger Canoes with their moored-boat shores, and the Island Start perk with its Choose Your Landing card.

modules.name: Paths, Swims and Climbs
modules.summary: Every FT_Path card (shore walks, cave entrances, swims, climbs, the forest trails west and north), the swim GIFs, and Rope and Pitons for the cliff.

modules.name: Island Places
modules.summary: The island's 21 surface places (Landfall Strand to Fallen Dwelling, Fire Mountain and Sour Crater) as environment and location cards, and the Wrecked Ship.

modules.name: Island Caves
modules.summary: The eight surface caves and the eight-hall dark chamber chain (environments, locations, the Sea and Wave Grotto GIFs) and the Cave Darkness card.

modules.name: The Mountains
modules.summary: Scree Slope, Steaming Shelf, Windgap Col and the Greenstone, Rust and Glimmer Grottoes, the Hot Spring with its Spring Warmth stat and GIF, and the Rock Salt Seam.

modules.name: The Fjords
modules.summary: Fjord Head, Seal Skerry and Puffin Cliffs, and The Fjord sea card (wash, watch the water).

modules.name: The Grassland
modules.summary: Wildrye Plain and Sedge Fen, and the LandmarkSeed patch that stands Forest Lore's Standing Stones on Wildrye Plain.

modules.name: Shore and Sea
modules.summary: The island coasts' sea cards and The Sea (wash, dive, fill with sea water, sea dangers), its GIF, Driftwood Log, Shell-Strewn Sand, Tide Pool, Seashells, Seaweed, Shore Crab, Rock Prawn and Sea Water.

modules.name: Fishing
modules.summary: The seven sea fish and three shellfish, their hidden stock stats, the Fish Trap (blueprint, card, set) and the set Funnel Trap.

modules.name: Coconuts and Palms
modules.summary: Coconut Palm (grown, felled, young), green and husked coconuts, coconut water and meat, the Coconut Shell Bowl, Palm Frond, and coconut meat in the vanilla stew.

modules.name: Tropical Food Plants
modules.summary: Banana, Mango, Tropical Almond, Jujube, Nipa Palm, Wild Yam (Baked Yam) and Sago Palm (pith, dried pith, dough, flatbread): wild plants, produce, garden growing and garden cards, and the Dead Plant.

modules.name: Medicine, Spice and Fibre Plants
modules.summary: Ginger, Kava, Chilli, Lemongrass, Jasmine, Aloe Vera, Cinchona (with the Cinchona Decoction) and Coffee, China Rose, Spider Lily, Weevil Lily and Snake Grass: plants, produce, garden cards, and their effect stats.

modules.name: Animals
modules.summary: Macaque, monitor lizard, cobra, seagull, bat, moose, seal, walrus and puffin: Animals manifests, encounters, carcasses, the bat picture (named only by its manifest), and the Seagull Nest.

modules.name: Climate
modules.summary: ClimateService: the card-less perceived-temperature changes for the island, volcano, mountains and fjords, and the art records of the four retired climate cards it replaced.

modules.name: Mod-wide
modules.summary: Plugin entry, EnvSaveDataPreCreate (pre-creates every board's save entry), OwlIslandGuard (Sirus23 compatibility), project files, player docs, card motion, and art tooling state.
